Duration constant

You bet on guns for a living. You have been ahead for so long that the house stopped counting.

Your Hot Load uses per day are equal to your Constitution modifier plus 3, and a Hot Loaded Strike that hits deals two additional damage dice rather than one. You still roll Gun Failure (§3) on a miss unless another feat says otherwise.

cinderfall.incomplete: a daily-use formula for a resource (Hot Load charges) that has no rule-element representation anywhere to attach a formula to. This card depends on (upgrades, extends, or is gated behind) another Ironsight card in this same package that itself ships rules: [] -- if the parent has nothing real to build on, the child has nothing real to extend either.
